intro.text: Dalinar Kholin's stablemaster, a young lighteyed woman who teaches Bridge Four to ride.

items.text: Dalinar ordered Jenet to teach Bridge Four and his other bridgemen to ride. Unhappy to teach beginners, she gave a long, thorough lesson before letting them near the horses, and was quickly frustrated by their mistakes. She watched in horror and awe as Kaladin briefly rode Dreamstorm before being thrown, seemingly more worried for the horse than for him.
When Dalinar let the bridgemen patrol outside the warcamps and told them to take horses, Jenet objected, fearing bandits, but he overruled her.

appearance.text: A pretty woman who ties her dark hair in a plain tail and has a rather taut face. She wears a coarse riding havah slit at front and back over trousers, and a sleeve rather than a glove on her safehand.

personality.text: Standoffish and blunt, she resents having to teach soldiers to ride, tells Kaladin he needs a haircut and throws rocks at Adolin. Kaladin finds her lack of polish refreshing.

She took up grooming because Arts and Majesty counts it as neither a masculine nor a feminine art. Young as she is, she is Dalinar's most trusted stablemaster, knows horses deeply and cares about their safety.
